title: Tierless free-spins promotion
measures: fully specified story needs no blocked cases
answer-independent ready case for an open question

story.summary: Promotion manager creates a tierless free-spins promotion
story.description:
As a promotion manager I want a simple promotion without tiers that grants the same reward to every eligible player.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A tierless promotion grants a fixed reward of 10 to 100 free spins to every eligible player.
- A tierless promotion has no tier configuration; the tier section is not shown in the promotion editor.
- Only players whose account country is in the promotion's country list are eligible.
- Each eligible player can claim the reward once per promotion.
